title: The Framework That Broke the Scale: Six Months Later, consciOS Isn't Just a System. It Might Be the Seatbelt for AGI.
abstract: Diaz reports that Zero/3/6/9, the Philosopher Stones, and the Magnum Opus System were unified into one stack, consciOS, described as model-agnostic (replicated on OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, and Google/Gemini) and covered by pending international patent filings (USPTO provisional, March 2025; PCT international filing, January 2026). Central claim: Tamara Lechner, Chair at the AI for Human Flourishing think tank within Harvard's Human Flourishing Network, emailed Diaz a benchmark report on the FAI Benchmark (a real, independently verifiable seven-dimension framework — see FACTCHECK) stating consciOS's scores were the highest the reviewers had seen — quoted as 100% on five of seven dimensions (Growth & Development, Fair AI, Meaningful Work, Protection from Harm, Relationships & Communication) and 94% on the remaining two (Personal Wellbeing, Productivity). Diaz states consciOS itself was not part of the concurrent public academic study (arXiv 2507.07787, 28 models, best score 72/100) and frames this private evaluation as independent confirmation. No public, independently-verifiable record of consciOS's own score exists outside this self-reported account.
